content.text: Why even one missed milestone matters:

CDC placed each milestone @ the age by which ≥75% of children are expected to show it, so even one missing milestone = “actionable” (likely to prompt screening and poss Refer) and the “wait and see” approach = ↓.

the checklist milestones are ⍉develop standards and should ⍉be used as screening or diagnostic tools; if a develop concern = noted, next steps = screening and eval w formal tools, or Refer for services.
